author: Codex independent critical architecture/call-chain design
status: source-grounded prospective interface only; no implementation, model, test, build or board execution

main_result.boundary: A private per-DMA parent adapter must sit before the existing four-DMA AXI mux. It accepts the original parent AW locally, retains its metadata, and emits only child/repair AW and child LAST into the shared mux. A native preparation origin enters the real TL wrapper independently of that AW path. A trusted retained-result selection in the TC maps child IOVA to the saved PA without another walk.
main_result.reachability: This is implementable for an aligned one-source-AR/one-original-AW Normal DDR copy without changing the existing iDMA logical W counter or source byte sequence. It is not an existing platform interface. The original parent AW cannot remain visible to the shared mux, and a downstream-only LAST override cannot implement it.
main_result.source_engine_result: On true child W only, adapter input WREADY equals the real child-output handshake permission. During NULL drain, adapter input WREADY is0, output data/strobes are adapter-owned, and the old producer W stream remains held. Therefore NULL does not pop the existing source FIFO or advance the producer's parent counter. The producer's original WLAST appears only on its last true parent word. One aggregate parent B is returned only after all true words and all physical child responses settle.
main_result.required_source_changes: The successful aligned path needs functional resident-count visibility through buffer/transport/backend/wrapper, a start gate before the backend, and the private adapter; it does not need the iDMA core to count physical children. Error completion is a separate actual missing interface because the wrapper selects NO_ERROR_HANDLING. General cross-page/multi-original-AW source envelopes need an explicit job-envelope record and lifetime across original B responses, not an assumed one-AW shim.
main_result.novelty_boundary: CutForward already buffers a parent AW, emits resident subrequests with generated LAST and merges B transparently. This adapter organization and parent/child completion transparency are therefore ordinary components. Give the bounded-debt mechanism and a concrete resident-only CutForward-derived control the same preparation/trusted-PA/parent interface. The main rule's nonresident debt and successful continuation are judged separately; this card supplies no independent novelty or latency claim.
main_result.remaining_gate: Close the prepare access_ok semantics and actual lease-result/ref propagation, physical W retirement feedback and wrapper job-error completion. Those are necessary before any new child/repair RTL trial can represent the proposed contract.

initial_contract.geometry: Stable S-only translated Normal DDR; four fixed DMA DID/PID pairs; aligned 64-bit copy; one source AR and one original destination AW per active parent, equal true word count1..256 and each wholly within its own4KiB page; no MMIO/MSI/MRIF, exclusives, atomics, overlapping destination writes or source mutation. One parent and at most one physical child per DMA; a patch waits for the preceding child's actual B. Source READ and destination WRITE are independently authorized.
initial_contract.enable_transition: Enable only from complete quiescence. Existing queued ordinary requests, held VALID, W spills, B and R responses cannot be abandoned or reclassified. Do not mix a legacy request with the same flow/ID while a prepared parent is active.
initial_contract.producer_limits: The wrapper must hold an eligible job at the existing job FIFO head until its prepare success, then start the backend. Other AR/AW generated for that DMA are backpressured before leaving its private adapter. Source ARLEN and RLAST are preserved; source segmentation is not silently changed by child-write scheduling.
initial_contract.coverage_choice: This card's minimal closed version prepares complete destination coverage before source AR. Root's U=N-C<=actualQ relaxation is not reproved here. It can reuse the interface if a separate job-envelope record identifies all destination original AWs and the unprepared suffix, and primer lifetime spans their individual parent B responses.

native_prepare_interface.request: prep_valid/ready, {original normal trans_req fields, cookie={flow2, parent_sequence6, READ_or_WRITE1}}. Original fields are IOVA64/DID24/PIDvalid1/PID20/ttype4/priv1/is_debug1/bank1=116b. New request port is125b; is_debug is forced0, and ttype is actual UNTRANSLATED_R or UNTRANSLATED_W. No AW offer or W credit is created by this handshake.
native_prepare_interface.internal_origin: Create a TL-local126b frame {is_prepare1,cookie9,trans_req116}; expand the existing three-input request arbiter to four inputs and store all ten origin/cookie bits in the real request spill. Normal/debug/ATS ports construct origin0. Prep is initially serialized and excluded from the nonblock-hit candidate input, so it uses the actual slow request path. Bank alone cannot distinguish a normal request from preparation.
native_prepare_interface.response: prep_resp_valid/ready with cookie9, PA56, range3, permission_related_bits7, access_ok1, error1, ignore1, is_mrif1, cause12, bypass1:92b. The cookie must match the live flow/sequence/operation; a mismatched response must not grant permission or be consumed as a normal TC response. Origin remains until the dedicated response handshake. Add the prep response handshake to request-spill retirement; exclude that response from the ordinary slow/fast response arbiter.
native_prepare_interface.actual_authorization: A new prepare_access_ok latch starts0. Set it1 only on the fully successful normal authorization decision, after DDT/PDT/context/type/privilege/U/SUM/stage/page/access checks and the operation's required permission. Every failure keeps it0 even if DTF disables reporting or sends the FSM straight to COMPLETE. In the S-only initial scope additionally require source READ permission or destination WRITE permission, reject ignore/MRIF, and preserve the exact original request attributes. A flag saying PA was calculated or error==0 is insufficient.
native_prepare_interface.reporting_separation: Fault reporting and authorization are separate. FQ/CQ readiness and DTF may affect reporting, but cannot turn access_ok0 into a usable lease. Actual fault cause is meaningful only with a valid fault status.
native_prepare_interface.correction_record: An intermediate message suggested fault_code==0. Direct reading disproved it: tl_wrap.sv:1021 initializes error_code to TRANS_TYPE_DISALLOWED even on the normal request entry, and successful paths do not generally clear it. That suggestion is withdrawn. Do not amend the old stage83 card's error-code text into proof. This is a paper interface correction, not a newly executed DUT failure.
native_prepare_interface.stage_limit: tl_wrap.sv:1337 selects exported permission bits with en_2S_q&&en_2S_q and then uses G-stage bits. Those bits alone do not prove both stages' access rights. The initial S-only contract avoids claiming an unreviewed two-stage authority conjunction; general two-stage permission support needs an explicit complete check and context record.

trusted_child_and_source_path.reference_type: Add lease_valid1 and lease_ref={flow2,parent_sequence6}8 to internal prepared AW/AR channel types, nine bits each. Original DMA-facing channel types remain unchanged. The trusted adapter alone creates the reference; untrusted packet input cannot assert it. Its child AW still carries the original DID/PID/privilege and child IOVA, not an arbitrary caller-supplied PA.
trusted_child_and_source_path.TC_lookup: At a selected prepared AW/AR FIFO head, validate live sequence, flow decoded from original mux ID, DID/PID/PIDvalid, operation, privilege/attributes, stage contract, exact covered IOVA extent and lease access_ok. For a child, offset=childIOVA-parentDstIOVA; require a nonoverflowing aligned INCR span=(LEN+1)*8 within the validated WRITE extent. Compute PA=savedDstPA+offset with overflow/region checks. Source uses its own READ record and unchanged source AR range. Only the resulting internally validated PA enters comp AW/AR. A failed ref never falls through as an already authorized physical request.
trusted_child_and_source_path.why_ordinary_flags_do_not_suffice: The current mmu_atst/mmu_valid path chooses translated request semantics and can perform additional work or stage checks. It is not this retained-operation permission selection. Debug and PCIe ATS origins also have different semantics and response routes; do not steal either as a prepare port.
trusted_child_and_source_path.packet_propagation: Prepared header fields must survive the top channel typedefs, pre-mux adapter conversion, axi_mux, banked_ctl's explicit conversions, demux, each TC's AW/AR FIFO and completion selection. The final comp port remains the existing ordinary physical AXI type; lease fields are consumed inside the trusted TC. Add explicit forwarding for the new fields wherever current macros/converters enumerate only old fields.
trusted_child_and_source_path.no_extra_master: Keep the existing four-DMA mux and the IOMMU's single comp master. This avoids a new external physical-master ID namespace or fabric port. Native retained-result selection bypasses the walk inside the existing TC completion path; arbitration/W ordering are still real.
trusted_child_and_source_path.AR_and_B_IDs: ariane_soc IdWidth=4 and NumDMADevices=4 give local DMA IDs2. Existing mux prepends flow2, so physical ID is {flow2,originalID2}; configured AxID is0. Preserve those IDs. At most one physical child per flow makes its child B unambiguous; absorb it in the adapter's ledger, and later return exactly one B with the saved original parent ID. Original source R IDs/data/RESP/RLAST are forwarded unchanged. Different flows remain independently addressable; serializing all flows until every B is not required.
trusted_child_and_source_path.physical_feedback: The upstream child W handshake can precede actual comp W consumption through existing FIFOs/spills. Therefore retain separate producer-accepted true progress and physical true progress. At the IOMMU comp interface, push its AW flow into a physical-W-owner FIFO and attribute W handshakes/LAST from that FIFO head. Decode B by its original flow ID. Export physical events to the matching adapter. W strobes are all1 for eligible true words and all0 for NULL, permitting a real/null classification without a new W payload bit in this restricted copy contract. This boundary is the IOMMU's physical comp interface, not an assertion about internal MIG retirement time. Because AXI permits W before AW acceptance, the minimum prepared route deliberately gates the first comp W offer until its physical AW has handshaken and entered this owner FIFO. It also gates the matching internal WREADY. This is applied before first WVALID, never to withdraw an existing offer; charge its possible extra launch cycle equally to both controls. Without this gate or an explicit first-AW-offer reservation state, an AW-handshake-only owner FIFO would misattribute W.
trusted_child_and_source_path.lifetime: A NULL child LAST releases each physical W owner but not the logical source primer or parent WRITE lease. The record survives its physical B, cache eviction and later patches. Release original parent B only after the producer's real parent WLAST, all real parent words physically accepted, and every child B settled. Source authorization remains through actual source RLAST; full job/primer retirement is a separate event. Never reuse a sequence until all referencing queues, held offers and responses for it are empty; sequence width alone is not an ABA proof.

producer_handshake_proof: Accepting the original AW at the private adapter lets the backend enqueue its existing w_dp_req and original last-burst metadata. That parent AW never reaches a common W-owner FIFO.

In REAL mode, child output WDATA/STRB are the producer's current values; only LAST is derived from the frozen physical child length. Original producer WREADY is asserted exactly when this real child word is accepted. The existing iDMA buffer therefore pops and parent counter decrements once for each true word.

In NULL mode, generate stable zero data/zero strobes/child LAST using the child physical counter. Hold producer WREADY0. New source data may fill the old FIFO and make producer WVALID1, but none is acknowledged, discarded or counted as written during NULL.

Switch to NULL only when no prior true W offer is held. A held real WVALID packet cannot be withdrawn, changed to zero strobes or assigned a different LAST. Once a NULL offer is asserted it likewise stays stable until accepted; new source arrivals cannot cancel the chosen child drain.

After the child's B settles, a repair descriptor begins at the still-unwritten true offset. The producer's own W counter still expects those words. No rewind or regeneration of the source engine's logical bytes is needed for the eligible successful path.

The original producer's final real WLAST pops its original w_dp_req only once; individual physical child LASTs are not sent back as producer data handshakes. B aggregation preserves the original last-burst FIFO's one-response-per-parent expectation. A source AR may finish before that parent B and its FIFO still holds real source words.

error_completion_gap.actual_source: dma_core_wrap.sv:319 fixes ErrorCap=NO_ERROR_HANDLING, and idma_backend.sv:521 sets idma_rsp.error0. Transport forwards B RESP, but this configured backend would still report ordinary job success. Returning an aggregated SLVERR alone does not close successful/fault semantics.
error_completion_gap.minimal_required_interface: Gate the backend start until preparation success. A preparation failure can pop/reject the held job without launching the original engine, emit one explicitly failed job response and retain a cause/status for software. For post-start R/B errors, add an adapter job_failed event and override/merge the wrapper's idma_rsp error before frontend completion; define legal failure drain/abort and sticky error status. Alternatively enable and correctly connect the existing error handler, but this is a real additional change and needs its actual abort/metadata handshake reviewed.
error_completion_gap.not_claimed: No arbitrary-fault recovery protocol or driver/error-register map is implemented by this card. Successful source preservation is proved only under eligible successful memory responses. Failed operations must not be counted as successful experiments.

source_return_envelope_extension.root_frontier_implication: For U=N-C<=actualQ, the accepted source AR may span multiple destination original AWs generated by the iDMA legalizer. A single original AW's PA/length cannot describe the whole source return. Keep a job envelope and unique primer across those original AW/B boundaries. A first original parent may truly complete/B while the source envelope still contains later unprepared destination words.
source_return_envelope_extension.concrete_example: One source AR returns11 aligned words; the first destination page can accept8 and the next page needs3. The producer may generate original AW8 then AW3. A per-AW adapter can settle AW8 normally, collect AW3 and prepare its own WRITE page while the final3 source words are retained. Global primer identity must not disappear on the first original B. This is an interface example, not a run or reproof of the U<=Q rule.
source_return_envelope_extension.minimum_extra_binding: Under the initial <=2KiB job restriction, retain original job destination base64 and job extent12:76 extra bits per flow, plus exact descriptor/job identity and sequencing controls if not already in the parent lease. Retain the source AR/envelope record independently of the changing current destination AW. General multi-source-AR jobs need a queue of accepted return ranges or an explicitly serialized per-range contract; neither is free.
source_return_envelope_extension.source_engine_limit: This extension need not change the logical source byte stream if all original AWs are adapted in their original order and their individual producer LAST/B relationships are preserved. If implementation instead insists one whole-job synthetic producer AW or arbitrary producer segmentation, explicit engine/legalizer child support is required. It cannot be inferred from the old transport counter.
source_return_envelope_extension.actual_geometry_from_root: Root directly checked the legalizer: at64b, aligned source0x800 with256 words and destination0x818 gives a first destination region of253 words plus tail3; destination0x820 gives252 plus tail4. Source AR remains one256-word burst and destination produces two original AW parents. Primer lifetime must span both original parent B responses. Tail4 is not asserted as a board deadlock: all per-flow/shared R spills and exclusive return storage must be counted before claiming that a held fourth word reaches a common blocked R stage.

concrete_same_interface_ordinary_control.name: resident-only CutForward-derived C=3 control
concrete_same_interface_ordinary_control.implementation: Use the same private parent record, native READ/WRITE preparation, source admission, retained PA lookup, per-flow ID rule, physical event accounting and B aggregation. Export/reserve three real contiguous words in the existing iDMA FIFO, then offer a child of length min(3,parent remaining) only when its complete payload is resident. Generate child LAST locally, forward only true W, and merge child B into the saved parent B. Do not duplicate its payload in another buffer unless the candidate gets equal total storage.
concrete_same_interface_ordinary_control.storage_reuse: The published design has its own cut-and-forward data buffer. Here the resident-only rule is ported to the common interface by reserving existing iDMA FIFO words until consumption. This is a concrete derived control, not a claim that the unmodified published RTL directly shares this iDMA buffer. A literal extra C-word implementation must have those extra payload slots charged to both methods.
concrete_same_interface_ordinary_control.common_minimal_child_limit: This card's minimal route has one physical child outstanding per flow and waits for its B before reusing the descriptor. Apply that same limit to the candidate and this control. The published CutForward permits more pipelining; a stronger version with concurrent child Bs requires its own complete B ledger and may perform better. This card does not establish superiority over that stronger version.
concrete_same_interface_ordinary_control.exact_component_equivalence: Parent capture, pre-mux segmentation, generated physical LAST, source-stream transparency, native permission preparation and same-region PA reuse are common components. The control never owes absent real words at child commitment and never needs NULL or a same-range successful repair. Candidate debt-cap/NULL/monotone-repair differences remain the root/B mechanism question, not an interface novelty claim.

types_and_storage_budget.width_basis: 64b AXI address/data, PAddr56, original local ID2, DID24/PID20; U is actual AXI user width. AXI-IOMMU typedef lines36–78 give parent AW=151+U and AR=145+U bits. Evaluate below at U=1 as an explicit parameter case, not a synthesized actual area result.

types.type: TL internal request with true origin

per_flow_parent_record.fields: two ranges and two complete returned permission-related flag groups
parent sequence, context generation, separate source/destination access_ok
source inflight/RLAST, producer WLAST, parent B valid, private AW/AR captured
true words producer-accepted and physically accepted

per_flow_child_record.fields: child offset, frozen length and emitted physical beats
AW accepted, physical LAST observed, B pending, held offer mode

global_added_storage.fields: prepare selection RR plus busy flow/operation/valid
depth4 physical comp W-owner FIFO flow2 plus head/tail/count
ten added origin/cookie bits in actual slow request spill
four-input TL request RR cursor if fairness replaces current priority

existing_storage_width_increases.fields: two TC banks, each AW8/AR8 FIFO, nine reference bits per header
one mux AW spill and one AR spill, nine reference bits each

types_and_storage_budget.resident_export: Connect existing per-byte FIFO usage and compute a valid resident-word count; current idma_buffer.sv:44 leaves usage unconnected. In the aligned 3-deep case the exported count is2 bits. Route it through transport/backend/wrapper to the adapter. Exporting an existing functional count adds wires/selection logic; a timing register or wider BufferDepth count is additional state if used. Reserve the reported prefix exclusively before first child AW offer.
types_and_storage_budget.no_added_payload_in_minimal_success_path: The adapter uses the existing source FIFO and existing bus spills/W FIFO. NULL payload is a stable constant; real payload remains producer-owned until its real handshake. This does not remove existing downstream buffering from total resource accounting.
types_and_storage_budget.complete_cost_limits: 2495 is identified new storage in this concrete sketch, not complete physical cost. Count extra reference bits in every additional instantiated header spill, timing cut or explicit converter holding register; immutable parent/child fields can derive a stable AW combinationally but a new packed timing register is not free. Invalidation/revoke/wrap command state, job-error software registers/IRQ path, generalized parent/source queues and exact pulse buffering need their designs. No claim that the old stage83 1247-bit sketch is this complete interface.
types_and_storage_budget.physical_W_gate: The added comp W owner FIFO plus W-before-AW gating makes actual W event attribution explicit. No extra payload register is inserted by this logical gate; any timing cut is a charged addition. Final source-primer release requires physical AW acceptance and final true WLAST, independently of old B.

changed_modules_required.change: private original AW/AR capture; child/ref generation; stable real/NULL W selection; original WREADY control; parent/child/B ledger; exact one-parent intake

changed_modules_required.module: new native prepared-lease table/control, connected inside IOMMU top
changed_modules_required.change: READ/WRITE preparation identity, PA/range/access_ok records, trusted lookup and completion lifetime
new native request/response port, actual origin through spill/retirement, dedicated response route, explicit successful authorization result
prepared reference fields in typed queues/conversions; trusted saved-result completion selection; physical AW/W/B/R event attribution; admission consistent with unique primer/full reservation

changed_modules_required.module: ariane_peripherals_xilinx.sv and internal AXI-IOMMU typedef/assign conversions
changed_modules_required.change: insert adapter before existing shared mux; construct prepared internal channel types/ref propagation; connect prepare/resident/events; preserve ordinary physical comp interface
functional resident usage output; wrapper start/fault/job-completion interface. Preserve existing successful-byte W counter logic. An alternative enabled error handler is a separate real change

generic typed structs can carry added equal non-ID fields while preserving ID prepend; verify every current interface/explicit converter. No assumption that old AXI_BUS_EXT macros carry a new field automatically

direct_critical_source.fact: Existing request/response and separate TL ports lack a prepare origin; banked TC owns current ordinary comp path.

Origin must survive actual spill, separate/nonblock response selection and handshake; fault_code is not success validity; exported permission groups are not an unconditional two-stage authorization proof.
Real walker checks invalid PTE/read/A/D/stage restrictions and can fault; prepared authorization must not be a PA-only shortcut.
Bank owner guard uses AW/W and physical conversion preserves original ID; ref forwarding and lifecycle/event attribution are explicit additional work.
Original AW forwards directly; WREADY handshake pops true source bytes and decrements parent counter; producer LAST pops its original w_dp request; B directly signals write response.
Parent w_dp geometry and last-burst flags are separate queues; exactly one original B consumes one last-burst record. Configured no-error mode suppresses job error.
Descriptor/accepted-job fields are available before backend; NO_ERROR_HANDLING is explicit; intf is in the same file and current EXT macros enumerate old fields.
Byte-FIFO usage exists but is not exported; functional resident-count access is a real new port.
Four-DMA mux is before IOMMU; source ID prepend and original physical comp wiring determine the feasible boundary. Production DMA0/1 buffers remain512, others3.
Exact EXT AW/AR fields support the header-width formulas; a new lease ref is not already present.
First AW offer claims W FIFO before AWREADY; true child LAST is required at this mux, not only downstream.
ID is prepended while same non-ID typed fields propagate; response upper ID is stripped at original DMA boundary.
ID4/PA56/AXI64 geometry used in this ledger; AXI user width is a parameter and not inferred as fixed1 for all configurations.

primary_comparison.title: CutForward, TCAD2022 author PDF
primary_comparison.actual_read: SectionIII rules1–7, PDFpage4/web347–505; figure4 discussion PDFpages4–5/web515–564. Not a full paper or published RTL review.
primary_comparison.fact: The design privately buffers an original AW, waits for a resident chunk before shared request commitment, generates each chunk LAST, and merges all subrequest Bs into one transparent response. Thus source-engine-transparent pre-mux parent adaptation is a primary-evidenced ordinary capability. Its stated resident-only chunk commitment does not establish the root rule's normal-success nonresident debt and NULL continuation.

decision: Advance one concrete native-origin/trusted-result/private-parent interface design if the root/B capability survives the separate same-budget comparison. No downstream-only shim, ATS flag shortcut, discarded source word, fake parent B or implicit producer LAST rewrite is accepted. Close the explicit authorization/error/lifetime interfaces first; this card itself is a shared component and not a performance innovation result.
